# EMPIRIC TREATMENT: HOSPITAL ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (HAP)

Development of pneumonia 48 hours or more after hospital admission.

## Empiric Treatment (see below for MRSA history or clinically unstable patients)

Obtain MRSA nasal PCR and sputum culture before antibiotics, whenever possible.

Narrow therapy based on results of culture and susceptibility tests. Discontinue MRSA and/or Pseudomonas coverage if not isolated from respiratory cultures.

Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal PCR negative.

[Re-evaluate Nosocomial pneumonia at 72 hours](nosocomial-pneumonia-re-evaluation-at-72-hours)

---

References:

- Kalil AC et al. Clin Infect Dis 2016. 63:1.
- Parente D. Clin Infect Dis 2018. 67:1

- Luna CM. Crit Care Med 2003. 31:676.
- Up-to-date website
Therapy:
## Inpatient

Preferred:

Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 7 days

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R for 7 days

### History of MRSA infection/colonization < OR > clinically unstable (e.g., intubation, hypotension)

ADD MRSA coverage to a regimen above. Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal PCR negative.

< ADD > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h  R

## ER/UC

### Empiric Treatment (see below for MRSA history or clinically unstable patients)

Obtain MRSA nasal PCR and sputum culture before antibiotics, whenever possible.
Narrow therapy based on results of culture and susceptibility tests. Discontinue MRSA and/or Pseudomonas coverage if not isolated from respiratory cultures.

Preferred:
Cefepime 2 gm IV STAT [R]

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Levofloxacin 750 mg IV STAT [R]
### History of MRSA infection/colonization

### < OR > clinically unstable (e.g., intubation, hypotension)

ADD MRSA coverage to a regimen above. Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal PCR negative.
< < ADD > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV STAT [R]
